## Goal
Ship the invoice schema migration and redesign all six invoice-management UI flows together.

## Scope fence
- db/migrate.py
- web/app.py
- web/styles.css
- tests/

## Acceptance criteria
- The database migration preserves every existing invoice and is reversible.
- Create, edit, approve, reject, archive, and restore flows use the migrated schema.
- The six flows meet the new responsive layout and accessibility requirements.
- Migration and browser suites pass.

## Verification
```
uv run pytest tests/test_migration.py tests/test_invoice_browser.py -q
```
